items.title: Messi laat ook derde uitnodiging voor speciale wedstrijd in Verenigde Staten schieten

items.title: Danilo keert na halfjaar bij NEC terug naar zijn thuisland
items.summary: Danilo Pereira verkast naar Botafogo. De Braziliaanse spits speelde het afgelopen halfjaar nog op huurbasis bij NEC en ruilt het Schotse Rangers nu (tijdelijk) in voor een avontuur in zijn geboorteland.

items.title: Deschamps' assistenten schrijven dankbrief: 'Geschiedenis zal zich je herinneren'
items.summary: Didier Deschamps zwaaide na het wereldkampioenschap af als bondscoach van Frankrijk, na veertien jaar de scepter te hebben gezwaaid bij Les Bleus . In een open brief bedanken zijn trouwe assistenten, Guy Stéphan, Cyril Moine en Franck Raviot de trainer.

items.title: Pléa heeft tijd nodig bij PSV: 'Dat zag je ook'
items.summary: PSV-trainer Peter Bosz kan in de voorbereiding op het nieuwe seizoen minuten geven aan spelers die vorig seizoen weinig speelden door blessureleed. Zo startten Alassane Pléa en Ruben van Bommel zaterdagavond tegen Villarreal . Bij Pléa vond Bosz het zichtbaar dat de aanvaller op de weg terug is van zwaar blessureleed.

items.title: From Haaland love to Mexico’s Merlin: 26 memories from the 2026 World Cup
items.summary: Norway’s striker left his mark, as did Scotland’s fans in Boston, but Turkey’s dark horses fell at the first hurdle “I played with him on my PlayStation, and now I’ve scored against him,” Livano Comenencia said after converting Curaçao’s first World Cup goal past Manuel Neuer in their opening match against Germany. The smallest nation ever to qualify for the World Cup went on to lose 7-1 but that goal – their only one of the tournament – will go down in history. Continue reading...

items.title: Arsenal make shock approach to sign Vinícius Júnior from Real Madrid
items.summary: Brazil forward has one year left on contract at Bernabéu Vinícius future at Real uncertain after Mourinho arrival Arsenal are exploring a shock deal to sign Vinícius Júnior from Real Madrid. Arsenal have inquired about the Brazil international, who has one year remaining on his contract at the Bernabéu. It is believed any move for Vinícius – who scored 22 goals for Real last season and four for Brazil at the World Cup – is at a formative stage as Mikel Arteta seeks a marquee signing to build on the club’s first Premier League title in more than two decades. Continue reading...

items.title: Defoe’s shock Woking exit came after ‘growing concerns’, says club
items.summary: Director of football claims manager failed to turn up for training Former Spurs striker’s stint ended after four months Jermain Defoe’s departure from Woking came after “growing concerns” at the club with Jody Brown, the National League side’s director of football, claiming the former Tottenham striker failed to turn up for training. Defoe’s contract at the National League club was mutually terminated on Thursday after four months in charge. In is first managerial job, the 43-year-old oversaw two wins and one defeat in six matches. The former England forward had said it was “impossible for me to continue” and described his time at the club as an “eye-opening” experience. Continue reading...

items.title: Missing a major football tournament? Fear not, Wafcon 2026 is about to start
items.summary: The Women’s Africa Cup of Nations starts in Morocco on Sunday, with Cape Verde and Egypt looking to continue feelgood factor from the men’s World Cup and Nigeria going for an 11th title The men’s World Cup may have finished but do not worry, the Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (Wafcon) is ready to pick up where Spain and Argentina left off. The 34-match event will take place between 26 July and 16 August, which sandwiches it between football’s global showpiece and the start of the league season in Europe. Here’s your guide to one of the most underrated but interesting events on the sporting calendar. Continue reading...
